project: Mastery summer program: 3 students, 5 subjects, 14 weeks. One standard = one atom = one lesson to mastery.
week_1_status: Complete. All 45 Week 1 slots wired (3 students x 5 days x 3 subjects: math, reading, enrichment rotation Sci/SS/Spelling/Sci/SS). 25 new lessons authored in this build; 20 carryover from prior batch. Spelling replaces Japanese on Day 3 in the paid product; the 3 Japanese lesson files remain in the repo as a side project (not surfaced in product UI).
data_model: localStorage key 'edu.app'; progress[studentId][subjectKey][STANDARDCODE]={status,best,attempts,formA,formB,explain,pt,application,formAPassedAt,...}. studentId in sam/amelia/julie. subjectKey in math/reading/science/social/spelling. Pass = 7/8 on Form A then Form B (delayed, gated 24h on spelling). Supabase sync baked, no-op until keys set.
hard_rules: No em-dash or en-dash anywhere (grep U+2014 and U+2013 must be 0).
One self-contained HTML file per lesson; only external dependency is Google Fonts.
The static page must teach; interaction is layered on top.
Objectives are the verbatim standard; design choices (title, recipe, aesthetic) are labeled as choices.
AAA contrast, 44px tap targets, keyboard operable, honors reduced-motion.
No fixed viewport heights; flexbox with min-height. Geometric SVG only, no cartoons.

Mastery is gated on auto-graded Form A (>=7/8) plus a delayed Form B (>=7/8). No learner self-rating UI. The written explanation and out-loud performance task are ungated; the PT rubric shows read-only as adult guidance.
Save with a descriptive filename, no version numbers.

engine.fits: Grade 2 (and grade-appropriate Grade 3) base-ten number work, via a hundreds/tens/ones block-builder manipulative.
engine.does_not_fit: Grade 8 math, reading, science, social studies, Japanese; these need their own builders.
engine.cfg_template: build_sam_a2.py is the canonical CFG (about 88 lines). Required keys: file, student, sname, subject, subject_label, day(=code), grade, code, pass_mark, title, standard(verbatim), objectives[3], why, hook, predicts[3], guided_seed, synth, badge_line, bridge, reteach, warm[2], practice[6], retrieval[2], fade, formA[8], formB[8], explain, pt.
